method: Exact six-digit UNITID anti-join between pinned national shards and pinned 2024-25 IPEDS historical first-major completion institution keys. No interpretation of non-reporting reason.
limitations: No historical completions join is not proof that a school is closed, non-degree, lacks programs, is unaccredited, or does not currently admit students.
Eight-digit prefix matches are only string candidates, not authoritative parent/campus links.
Absence of SAT/ACT values cannot establish admissions test policy.
The 129 count applies only to six-digit national keys; 456 eight-digit display keys remain separate and held.
Institution URLs are Scorecard-reported and were not live HTTP verified in this audit.
